title: Heuristics: Evolutionary trajectory optimization for LLM alpha mining
rationale: QuantaAlpha introduces a novel insight over single-run AlphaAgent: treating each full mining run as a 'trajectory' and applying evolutionary operators (mutation of sub-optimal nodes, crossover of high-reward segments) across runs dramatically improves factor quality. IC 0.1501 vs AlphaAgent IC 0.0966 (+55%). This generalizes beyond factor mining to any multi-step LLM task where iterative trajectory refinement can be applied.
content:
### Evolutionary trajectory optimization for LLM alpha mining
- LESSON: Treating each LLM mining run as a 'trajectory' and applying evolutionary operators (mutation = rewrite sub-optimal decision nodes; crossover = merge high-reward segments from two parent trajectories) produces factors with IC 0.1501 vs IC 0.0966 for single-run AlphaAgent (+55% improvement). The key is localizing WHY a trajectory underperforms, not just resampling randomly.
- LESSON: Evolutionary alpha mining (QuantaAlpha) outperforms both AlphaAgent and RD-Agent on CSI300 by large margins. S&P 500 zero-shot transfer (factors mined on CSI300 deployed on US stocks without retraining) achieved 137% cumulative excess return 2022-2025. OHLCV+VWAP only — no fundamentals required.
- LESSON: A factor diversity constraint (|correlation| < 0.70 between any two pool members, ranked by RankIC descending) combined with a pool size cap (50% of total mined factors per iteration) prevents redundancy without sacrificing predictive power. Apply this to any factor pool management task.
- LESSON: Claude-4.5-Sonnet achieves functional results as the backbone LLM in QuantaAlpha (IC ~0.1252 vs GPT-5.2 IC 0.1501). When budget-constrained, use Claude for the CHAT_MODEL (debugging, feedback) and a reasoning model (o3-mini, DeepSeek-R1) for the REASONING_MODEL (hypothesis and factor generation) — the hypothesis generation step has highest leverage.
- WHEN: Designing any LLM-driven factor generation system (R33 and beyond). The trajectory-level evolutionary approach is the current state-of-the-art for formula alpha mining.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2602.07085 (Feb 2026, KDD 2025) — QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining. GitHub: QuantaAlpha/QuantaAlpha.
